title: `os doctor` ends with "Run with --verbose to see fix suggestions." when only warnings that have no fix suggestion fired
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTyMahdAdhXSzgy2nt

Filing gate: ① product defect (user-visible misleading copy) · Source: fleet · out-of-scope finding of PR #35377 (card #34866), os-dev-report 7002333905; L1 ACCEPT 7005940659 named it a follow-up card owed. ⛔ Not a claim.

Grade: area:build · Bug · Cosmetic · builders, often · measured once at the public door `os doctor` (built binary) → p2 (Cosmetic × builders, often).

## Business reason

A developer runs `os doctor`, sees warnings, and is told to re-run with `--verbose` "to see fix suggestions". For five kinds of warning there is no fix suggestion in either mode, so the re-run adds nothing and the developer is left without a next step on their first contact with the CLI.

## What happens

`packages/cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`: the `hasWarnings` summary prints the hint whenever any warning fired and `--verbose` is off (after PR #35377). Five warning paths print a bare `printWarning` with no fix channel in either mode: missing tests (`findMissingTests`), `@deprecated` usages (`findDeprecatedUsages`), circular dependencies, unused objects, orphan views.

reach: public door `os doctor` — built binary (`node packages/cli/bin/run.js doctor`) in a temp cwd carrying `packages/spec/src/a.zod.ts` with no `a.test.ts`: the plain run ends "Run with --verbose to see fix suggestions."; the `--verbose` run adds nothing to the "Missing test" warning (os-dev-report 7002333905).

## Expected

The hint is printed only when at least one warning that fired has a fix suggestion to show under `--verbose`, or those five warnings gain a real fix line. Either way, the summary never promises a suggestion that `--verbose` does not print.

## Done when

A pin with only a fix-less warning shows no hint; a pin with a fix-bearing warning keeps it.

Who acts: the area that owns `packages/cli` (area:build, CLI area).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue doctor "fix suggestions"` → 2 hits (#34866, the parent card, fixed by PR #35377; #5382 closed, unrelated).
